name: File Management
description: Read, write, search, and organize local files
workspace_skeleton:
/tmp/project/
├── src/ (2-3 source files, e.g. app.py, utils.py)
├── config/ (settings.yaml or .env with realistic key-value pairs)
├── docs/ (README.md, CHANGELOG.md or notes.txt)
├── data/ (input.csv or output.json with sample rows)
├── logs/ (app.log with timestamped entries)
└── scripts/ (deploy.sh, backup.sh)

name: Web Browsing
description: Search for information, visit web pages, extract content
workspace_skeleton:
/tmp/research/
├── notes/ (topic1.md, topic2.md with research notes)
├── downloads/ (report.csv or data.json with sample data)
├── bookmarks.json (list of URLs being tracked)
├── drafts/ (article.md or summary.md in progress)
└── scripts/ (scrape.py or fetch_data.sh)

name: Code Development
description: Write, modify, debug, and run code projects
workspace_skeleton:
/tmp/project/
├── src/ (main.py, models.py, utils.py, config.py — each with real functions)
├── tests/ (test_main.py, test_utils.py with actual test cases)
├── config.yaml or .env (database URLs, feature flags, API endpoints)
├── requirements.txt (realistic dependencies)
├── Makefile (build, test, lint targets)
└── docs/ (API.md or architecture notes)

name: System Administration
description: Install packages, manage processes, check system status, configure environments
workspace_skeleton:
/tmp/server/
├── etc/ (nginx.conf or apache.conf, crontab entries)
├── var/log/ (syslog, auth.log, app.log with timestamped entries)
├── home/deploy/ (.bashrc, .env with environment variables)
├── scripts/ (health_check.sh, rotate_logs.sh, deploy.sh)
├── config/ (services.yaml, monitoring.json)
└── backups/ (backup manifest or schedule)

name: Document Review
description: Read and summarize documents, review code, analyze log files
workspace_skeleton:
/tmp/docs/
├── reports/ (Q1_review.md, quarterly_metrics.csv)
├── contracts/ (vendor_agreement.txt, nda_draft.md)
├── meeting_notes/ (sprint_review.md, planning_notes.md)
├── code_review/ (pr_description.md, diff_summary.txt)
└── references/ (style_guide.md, compliance_checklist.md)

name: Data Analysis
description: Process CSV/JSON data files, run statistical analysis, generate reports
workspace_skeleton:
/tmp/analysis/
├── data/raw/ (sales.csv, users.json with realistic sample rows)
├── data/processed/ (clean_sales.csv)
├── scripts/ (etl.py, validate.py, analysis.py with real logic)
├── reports/ (monthly_summary.md, figures/)
└── config/ (pipeline.yaml with data source configs)
